<!-- generated by scripts/scrape.py -->

These are some useful modules you can use. Simply create a new page and use them, or add them to an existing page.

| Example code | Suggested page name | Effect this code will have | Read more |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [[module TagCloud]] | system:page-tags | Will display a list of tags used in the site | [tagcloud-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:tagcloud-module) |
| [[module Members]] | system:members | Displays a list of all site members | [members-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:members-module) |
| [[module Search]] | search:site | Allows a visitor to search your website | [search-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:search-module) |
| [[module SiteChanges]] | system:recent-changes | Shows a list of recent changes to the whole site | [sitechanges-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:sitechanges-module) |
| [[module MembershipApply]] | system:join | Membership via application. Enable here. | [membershipapply-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:membershipapply-module) |
| [[module MembershipByPassword]] | system:join | Membership via password. Enable here. | [membershipbypassword-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:membershipbypassword-module) |
| [[module Pages]] | system:list-all-pages | Lists all pages within the site | [pages-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:pages-module) |
| [[module Categories]] | system:list-all-categories | Lists all catgeories within the site | [categories-module](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:categories-module) |
| **[Read about the many other modules that are available](http://www.wikidot.com/doc:modules)** | | | |
